knowledge.content: Target 1 - AppMetadata struct fields (in root fyne package, app.go): ID string, Name string, Version string, Build int, Icon Resource. Default values when not set: ID="com.example", Name="Fyne App", Version="1.0.0", Build=1
Target 1 - SetMetadata function must be in app sub-package at app/meta.go, not root package. App.Metadata() method must be added to App interface and all implementations updated.

Target 2 - Hex color parsing formats: 3-digit (abc→0xaa,0xbb,0xcc,0xff), 4-digit (abcd→0xaa,0xbb,0xcc,0xdd, note: #rgb with 4 chars starting # is # + 3-digit), 6-digit (a1b2c3→0xa1,0xb2,0xc3,0xff), 8-digit (a1b2c3f4→0xa1,0xb2,0xc3,0xf4). All formats work with or without # prefix.

Target 2 - JSON theme color resolution order: variant-specific colors (Colors-dark/Colors-light) checked first, then generic Colors, then default theme fallback. FromJSON returns default theme + error on parse failure.

Target 3 - NewSprintf Set() special handling: Bytes cannot be round-tripped (returns error), URI is parsed via storage.ParseURI not fmt.Sscanf. StringToStringWithFormat must return original binding directly (no wrapping) if format is "%s".
Target 4 - MenuItem.Icon and MenuItem.Shortcut fields must be added to MenuItem struct in root fyne package (menu.go). Both Menu.Refresh() and MainMenu.Refresh() methods required.

Target 5 - Toolbar constructor return types must change: NewToolbarAction returns *ToolbarAction (not ToolbarItem), NewToolbarSpacer returns *ToolbarSpacer, NewToolbarSeparator returns *ToolbarSeparator. ToolbarAction.SetIcon method must update Icon field and refresh toolbar.

Target 6 - Container.RemoveAll() sets Objects to nil and triggers re-layout. Container.Add(nil) must be no-op. Entry.SetMinRowsVisible(count int) overrides default 3 rows; uses count in MinSize() when count > 0. validation.NewAllStrings in data/validation/all.go returns first error or nil.
Target 6 - Hyperlink.OnTapped func() field in widget/hyperlink.go: when non-nil, tapping calls OnTapped instead of opening URL. When nil, preserves existing URL-opening behavior.
Target 7 - desktop.App interface in driver/desktop/app.go with two methods: SetSystemTrayMenu(menu *fyne.Menu) and SetSystemTrayIcon(icon fyne.Resource).
